conditions: Every frozen requirement ID has one or more mappings
Every mapping normalizes to the canonical evidence mapping schema
Every mapped chunk is authorized by ACL, tenant, and region
Document, document-version, version, and chunk identities validate
Every supporting span is a literal substring of its cited chunk
Every citation is known and authorized
No equally grounded contradictory direct fact exists
No temporal ambiguity or unresolved version conflict exists
No unsupported semantic inference is required
Universal Completeness Gate and deterministic assembler pass

direct_extraction.ambiguity_policy: Equally grounded facts fail closed; retrieval rank never breaks a semantic tie
direct_extraction.method: Recognized literal relation grammar plus normalized subject anchors
direct_extraction.unsupported_behavior: Requirements outside recognized direct-extractive structures continue through Luna/Sol routing

model_roles.A: Complete deterministic direct support -> deterministic answer
model_roles.B: Plausible but incomplete or ambiguous evidence -> Luna
model_roles.C: Genuinely ambiguous Luna result eligible under frozen policy -> Sol

security: The deterministic path does not bypass authorization, temporal validity, injection protection, citation validation, contradiction checks, or completeness.
